caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles an urn or a vessel with a lid, supported by a stand and resting on a flat, circular base, similar to a tray. The main vessel has a rounded, tapering body with a narrow neck and a small cylindrical finial on top of the lid. There are two thin, curved supports extending from the upper sides of the vessel down to the base where they attach to a central vertical support structure. The central support rises from the circular base and seems to cradle the vessel above it. The color of the drawing is monochromatic, using shades of gray pencil or graphite on a beige, slightly yellowed background. The upper large section of the page shows the urn and stand in a frontal elevation view, enclosed within a large square border. Below this main drawing, there are three smaller squares, each containing different technical views. The first box on the left shows a side elevation view with some measurements. The middle box shows a top-down circular view of the vessel and stand. The third box presents another top-down but more detailed cross-sectional view of the base and vessel. At the bottom, between the two middle boxes, there is a horizontal line labeled "SCALE: 1 IN" that indicates the scale of the drawing.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
